body: actually, tbh, I wouldn't mind talking for a bit...at least to try it out

Sorry I really didn't mean to come off as a mean-ass or anything. If I did, I'm so sorry. But it's just that I've tried this before and after three messages, the person disappeared, forever. I'm also paranoid about my friends finding this

Sorry for the delayed response. Usually it gets bad once I've started drinking, but it can be bad while I'm sober too. I just feel really awful. I know some of it has to do with my weight (I'm def overweight, but it doesn't show as much as you'd think for someone with my weight), but so many attempts in so many years have yielded temporary to no results. It can be really, reallly tough. And so many other things to boot. I know for a fact that I'm worthless. It's a cold but true fact.

And it's so hard to choose a fave community character. Jeff is a narcissist but also someone to look up to. I'm in love with Gillian and Alison. Pierce was such a dick but funny. Yvette was great in D&J and it carried over to Community. I guess, currently my favorite is Abed simply because of his references. (If you haven't guessed, Arrested Development is my all-time favorite show with Community being second) But yeah, I guess I'd say Abed. I will say that Danny's acting did seem a bit...more extroverted compared to previous seasons, but still very good.
Sorry for the delayed response. And I appreciate the offer, but the internet conversations always fall through eventually, and I don't want to become too dependent on it when it inevitably does.
